task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a pale, smooth, tubular structure with faint red vascular markings occupying the upper left, moving across the frame to reveal a dark, moist cavity with thin, branching red vessels on a yellowish-brown tissue surface. The camera pans and tilts, causing motion blur and shifting focus, before the view narrows into a circular, tunnel-like perspective looking down a smooth, greyish-brown lumen. Through the central opening, a glistening, yellowish, lobulated mass with small red capillaries is visible, appearing to be manipulated or viewed from a distance as the camera pulls back, creating a concentric ring effect with the surrounding tissue.
